notes: Impedance control is one checkbox; the 90 ohm target can't be entered. Assembly anomaly resolved: $117.41 is the real qty-5 price. At qty <= 10 the engine charges max($88, $25.27 + $0.1523 x parts/board x qty) whenever the $29 promo is off: 25.27 + 0.1523 x 121 x 5 = $117.41. The $371.99 seen at 116 SMD parts is only the struck-through 'list' price next to $29. It comes from the qty >= 11 formula (setup + unique-part fees): this board costs $209.45 at qty 10 and $385.69 at qty 11. The promo drops at 117 SMD parts because 120 x 5 = 600 is the order part limit; the server treats 600 as over. Five: no promo (605 parts > 600). One: $29 promo applies; normal is the $88 minimum.
